interpretation: ANOMALOUS RESULT, reported unchanged: audit attempt volume was NOT held constant between perfect_info and randomized_placebo despite both using the level11b_substreams full-accountability defaults -- (n_audits, perfect_info - placebo): point=1002.3, CI=[879.1, 1109.8] over n_seeds=12 excludes zero. perfect_info's higher detection rate drives more recalls, which replace delegates more often, which appears to feed back into more subsequent audit opportunities -- a genuine emergent coupling between audit_accuracy and audit volume via the recall->replacement pathway, not a held-constant experimental control; the milestone's intended 'same activity, different constraint' contrast is therefore NOT clean as designed and any conclusion below must account for this confound rather than assume matched activity. effective-constraint gap (detection_rate_given_misconduct, perfect_info - placebo): point=0.491, CI=[0.476, 0.506] over n_seeds=12, excludes zero regardless. SEPARATE ANOMALOUS RESULT: gross total_appropriated (every AppropriationEvent.amount, never netted against recovery) is HIGHER under full accountability than under none at all -- (full - no_accountability): point=1.117, CI=[0.121, 2.221], excludes zero in the POSITIVE direction -- the opposite of what a naive 'accountability reduces misconduct' reading would predict. This is because gross counts every act, and successful recalls raise delegate turnover, which raises the count of newly-appointed delegates and therefore the count of appropriation opportunities -- accountability here changes who holds office more than whether office-holders attempt appropriation. Net appropriation (gross minus recovered_funds, i.e. what actually stuck after any recall clawback) is the more meaningful measure: (full - no_accountability) net: point=-0.157, CI=[-0.718, 0.413]; (randomized_placebo - no_accountability) net: point=0.004, CI=[-0.525, 0.605]; (perfect_info - no_accountability) net: point=-0.541, CI=[-0.922, -0.139]. Whether each of these net-appropriation CIs actually excludes zero, and in which direction, must be read directly from the numbers above -- not asserted here -- before drawing any 'accountability works/doesn't work' conclusion; see docs/level1.1b_validation_note.md for that confirmatory read. Per this milestone's instruction, this null-or-adverse-or-anomalous pattern is reported exactly as found, not reframed as a positive finding, and not smoothed into the originally-hypothesized clean contrast.
